messages:
maria: Heads-up: opened docs PR for SDK migration snippets — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823. Need merge timing vs release 3.2. Targeting release cutover Tue 2025-06-10 16:00 UTC. Who can review? cc @alex @sam

docs-bot: Docs preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4823 (build queued) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: :eyes: I'll take reviewer. Quick question — does this change need versioned path under /v2/ or should it replace /sdk/?

maria: It should add /v2/ and keep /sdk/ redirect. We need the migration guide updated too — PR includes the snippet but not the step-by-step.

sam: CI preview failed on snippets build: error unknown placeholder in codeblock. Logs: `Error: missing param 'region' in snippet_runner`

maria: On it — pushing fix in a sec. Will also tag @jess for QA on rendered examples.

jess: Can we hold merge until canary docs build passes on dedicated infra? Last time the preview flagged table rendering in /api/auth.

docs-bot: Preview build failed: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7241 — failing step `render-examples`

maria: Fixed placeholder, pushed 1755554330. Thanks for the heads up. New preview should be live in ~5m.

docs-bot: New preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-4823/changes (build succeeded) :white_check_mark:

alex: Review complete. Left two minor wording nits and one request: add a short note about feature flag `sdk_v2_enabled` and fallback behavior.

maria: Added note and example snippet for flag check: ```python
if flags.is_enabled('sdk_v2_enabled'):
    client = SDKV2()
else:
    client = SDKV1()
```

sam: LGTM from me once canary passes. Quick ask — can we sequence merges: 1) migration guide (this PR), 2) SDK sample repo update, 3) versioned redirects? Avoid broken links during cutover.

jess: Agree. I'll coordinate with release ops. We only have a 30min window after cutover to merge non-blocking docs. Anything that changes paths must go in before cutover.

maria: Plan: block merge until release ops gives green at 2025-06-10T15:30Z, then merge migration guide, then ping @platform to merge redirect config. @sre-bot will monitor.

sre-bot: Acknowledged. Will watch for deploy window and alert on redirect config propagation. :robot_face:

alex: :thumbsup: I'll queue SDK sample PR and mark as blocked until docs merged.

maria: Thanks all. If no more blockers, I'll request merge at 2025-06-10T15:31Z. Leaving this thread open for last-minute nits.

jess: :raised_hands: thanks! :party_parrot:

maria: Merge done at 1755554395 — migration guide merged, redirect config queued. Closing thread after redirect verified.

sre-bot: Redirects live across CDN in 2m. Verified at 1755554400. :white_check_mark:
